title.zh: 费用（印花税裁定）（减免）命令

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Order may be cited as the Fees (Adjudication of Stamp Duty) (Remission) Order.

heading.en: Remission of adjudication fee payable under Stamp Duties Act

text.en: 2. The adjudication fee payable under section 37(1) of the Stamp Duties Act (Cap. 312) in respect of any instrument relating to the transfer of any Housing and Development Board flat shall be remitted where the stamp duty in excess of $10 on that instrument has been remitted pursuant to the Order dated 19th April 1990 made under section 75 of the Stamp Duties Act (Cap. 312, O 2).
